target: doctor.sh forge section (github) — a missing gh is a [FAIL]
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_gh auth_status 0 "Logged in"
unset FORGE FORGE_URL FORGE_REMOTE FORGE_TOKEN GITLAB_TOKEN
fx_remote https://github.com/o/r.git
fx_nogh
command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo gh_on_path=yes || echo gh_on_path=no
fx_doctor
fx_sec_has fail_lines '\[FAIL\]'
fx_sec_has mentions_gh '\[FAIL\].*gh'
fx_done
